title: Massive News for Anthropic Stock Investors as IPO is Hugely Successful  | ANT Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc covers Anthropic pricing its IPO at $83 a share — above the prior $80 estimates — at a market capitalisation near $1.4tn, with shares set to begin trading on Thursday 19 November. The deal was about 6x oversubscribed, which he says is not informative since most IPOs of this size are. It caps back-to-back 2026 mega-IPOs: SpaceX and Anthropic, each worth over $1tn (SpaceX approaching $2tn), with OpenAI scheduled to come to market next year. Anthropic is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world: Q3 revenue reached $17bn, up 12x year over year, and it has leapfrogged OpenAI as the leading AI company, with computing efficiency improving so it earns more revenue per dollar of compute. Operating income improved notably in the latest quarter. He estimates the IPO raises about $100bn between the public and private placements, taking cash above $200bn — enough to reach a self-sustaining, cash-flow-neutral footing and fund next-generation models and inference spending. That is great news for the AI ecosystem: Anthropic spends hundreds of billions on computing, supporting Nvidia, AMD, Micron, Intel, Broadcom, TSMC and SK Hynix, and the raise eases fears about whether AI customers can pay their contracted obligations. He still warns the pattern may repeat SpaceX's — shares jumped above $200, then fell and stayed below the peak despite strong execution — so he expects an initial jump, then a settle. He calls Anthropic 'one of the best AI companies in the market right now', the only pure-play large-language-model and agentic-AI platform, and says he is 'very interested in owning shares' but not in the early days: he is waiting for the shares to settle and for more information before deciding. Calls: ANT CONDITIONAL_BUY (first tracked for Parkevtate).
